title: K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook
abstract: arXiv:2610.00074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. translated_title: K-Dense BYOK：一个可本地运行并维护哈希链式实验笔记本的开源AI研究助手
translated_abstract: K-Dense BYOK（自带密钥，bring your own keys）是一款免费的开源AI研究助手，面向任何领域的科学家，可运行在研究人员自己的计算机上。研究人员提供自己所选模型的访问权限（托管或本地运行均可），应用程序则提供其余的一切：工作运行的环境、一层科学脚手架以及完整的记录。每个项目都是一个普通文件夹，因此数据、代码、结果和记录都保存在研究人员自行管理的机器上，即使多年后无需该应用程序也能读取。有三点使其区别于聊天助手或通用编码代理：它附带了一个书面科学程序库、引导式工作流模板、研究数据来源目录，以及代理可将工作分派给的审稿人和写作者角色；它维护一本“活页实验笔记本”（Living Lab Notebook），其条目相互链接形成论证链，且只可追加、永不删除；它记录所发生的一切……
tldr: K-Dense BYOK是一款在研究者本地计算机上运行、自带模型密钥的开源AI科研助手，以普通文件夹保存全部数据与记录，并通过科学程序库、引导式工作流和只增不删的哈希链式活页实验笔记本，区别于普通聊天助手和通用编码代理。
en_tdlr: K-Dense BYOK is a free, open-source AI research assistant that runs locally on researchers' own computers with their own model keys, stores all data, code, and records in ordinary folders, and distinguishes itself from chat assistants through scientific procedure libraries, guided workflows, and an append-only, hash-chained Living Lab Notebook.
